purpose: the standing rules in force as P-0c opens, and the ones that are not

OD-001.statement: the registered ceiling is measured in actively used GPU-hours; VM wall-clock and allocated GPU-hours are reported separately and are not bound by it
OD-001.note: no GPU ceiling applies to P-0c, but the three quantities are still reported separately and none substitutes for another

OD-011.statement: a check must carry a demonstrated failing case, or it counts as not implemented; AND the demonstration must include a case that must return POSITIVE
OD-011.why_revised: three must-return-negative cases are passed by a rule that always returns the negative

OD-017.statement: before any pre-registered criterion is applied to data, a line-by-line conformance table of registered text against implemented behaviour must be produced and committed, comparing LIVE values

OD-021.statement: a criterion issued by the ADJUDICATOR must pass OD-017 conformance before entering a pre-registration; the adjudicator's instruction does not exempt it from verification
OD-021.precipitated_by: the P-0' prescribed estimand turning out to be the one already in use

OD-022.statement: a candidate estimand must be evaluated under a purely destructive patch from CLEAN RUNS ALONE, and reported, before it may be registered; not approximately zero means not registrable
OD-022.precipitated_by: the same event; the sweep killed the whole difference-ratio family with no GPU work and predicted the failure value in advance

proposed_not_in_force.OD-018: a null must be demonstrated quiet before it may set a ceiling
proposed_not_in_force.OD-019: an estimand must be shown to separate the movement it names from movements it does not
proposed_not_in_force.OD-020: a baseline must be measured under the same execution conditions as the quantity it is subtracted from
proposed_not_in_force.note: OD-022 substantially covers OD-019's concern for the specific case of destructive perturbation, and P-0''s bit-exact repair discharged OD-020's concern in practice; none of the three is thereby put in force, and the operator decides

the_directionality_precedent.rule: changing the IMPLEMENTATION to match the REGISTERED TEXT is a bug fix; changing the REGISTERED TEXT to match the DATA is p-hacking. The difference is the direction, not the outcome

the_disciplines_carried_forward_that_are: a failed repair is committed, not discarded; the first batch-baseline attempt at 0.5543 is in the record
motivation asymmetry is disclosed whenever a check would only have been thought of on an unfavourable result
a rule whose count could inform it is pushed before the count is computed
an artifact of record is rendered FROM the committed JSON rather than retyped, so the readable copy cannot drift
claim_ceiling: A governance index. It licenses no claim of any kind.
